showcase_cases.label: Case A · GNN recalled / DS missed (#1613)
showcase_cases.summary: MC 6 (e+, conv, 480.2 MeV/c, 5 layers): V5 (-1.30%) & V6 (-1.85%) recalled cleanly; DS found only the leading electron (0 overlap with 2nd track).

showcase_cases.label: Case B · GNN recalled / DS fit failed (#2589)
showcase_cases.summary: MC 5 (e+, conv, 545.7 MeV/c, 6 layers): V6 (+0.28%, 6/6) & V5 (-1.79%, 5/6) converged; DS mixed partner-track hits (purity 0.50, chi2/ndf 1267) and failed GenFit convergence.

showcase_cases.label: Case C · Both GNN & DS recalled (#86)
showcase_cases.summary: MC 5 (e+, conv, 567.3 MeV/c, 6 layers): Control event where DS, V5 and V6 all recover 6/6 layers cleanly (purity 1.00, dp/p -1.02%).
